comment: The SHAPES jacks and the OUTPUT jack carry whatever is patched into them, audio or control voltage alike, so they are given no family. SELECTION_PARAM holds which row is selected and has no ParamWidget, so it cannot be clicked and carries no line; it is a parameter rather than a plain member so that the selection survives a patch reload. The crossing tolerance is fixed at 0.01V and is not on the panel or the menu. ENABLE is read as a level at 5V while every other jack on the panel uses Rack's default 1V trigger threshold.
